# ADO502: invalid-task-input

A task input isn't defined for this built-in task version, or has a value outside its allowed list.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Category** | Tasks |
| **Default severity** | warning |
| **Enabled by default** | yes |
| **Checked on** | schema validation of task steps in the expanded pipeline |

## Description

The input name (or one of its aliases) isn't defined for the task version, or a pick-list or boolean input has a value the schema doesn't allow. Matching is case-insensitive. The schema can lag behind new task releases, so value findings are warnings.

The embedded schema describes 259 built-in task versions. Tasks referenced by GUID are not checked.

## Example

Problem:

```yaml
- task: Bash@3
  inputs:
    targetType: inline
    scrpt: echo hi
```

Instead:

```yaml
- task: Bash@3
  inputs:
    targetType: inline
    script: echo hi
```

## Configuration

Change the severity or turn the rule off in `.adolint.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  ADO502: off   # off | info | warning | error
```

Or on the command line: `adolint lint --disable ADO502` or `--enable ADO502`.

Suppress a single finding with a comment on the line before it (or `disable-line` at the end of the line):

```yaml
# adolint:disable-next-line ADO502
```
